features.title: Easier upgrades and a free plan for self-hosted Agenta
features.body:
We keep working on self-hosted Agenta, and this release brings three changes. You can move from the open source edition to Enterprise with a license key, without changing your images. There is a new free Registered plan, and when you register your instance from the app, you get a free key that removes the project limit.

We also reworked self-hosted telemetry, so that each instance counts once and test installs no longer mix with real ones. The [Telemetry page](https://agenta.ai/docs/self-host/telemetry) lists what an instance sends and how to turn it off. The [license keys page](https://agenta.ai/docs/self-host/license-keys#limits-by-plan) compares the plans.

improvements.text: The app tells you when a new release or a security fix is out
On the Community and Registered plans, the Access & Security and Audit Log settings show what Enterprise adds, and where to enter a key
The migration job can run for up to one hour, up from 10 minutes
Enterprise Helm installs pull public images and need no pull secret

features.title: Meet the builder agent
features.body:
We reworked how you build and improve agents. The builder agent is a new agent that builds your other agents. Tell it what you want in plain words, and it creates the agent and writes its instructions, tools and skills.

Open it from **Builder** in the sidebar to start something new. Or call it from the panel next to any agent when you want to change that agent. The builder can build an agent, run it, find what went wrong and improve it. We will keep making it better.

improvements.text: The agent pages, automations and settings now work on a phone
When you sign in to a new MCP server, you choose who in the project can use that sign-in
A Bedrock connection can switch between an API key and access keys
Builder chats have their own group on the Sessions page

fixes.text: A run that stopped with an error now shows as failed, not as running

features.title: New models for your agents
features.body:
Your agents can use these new models.

Built-in models, paid with your Agenta credits like the other built-in models. You need no key of your own:

- Gemini 4 Hydrogen
- Gemini 4 Carbon
- Gemini 4 Neon

With your own provider key or subscription:

- Claude Fable 5.2
- Claude Haiku 5.5
- GPT-6.2 Astra
- GPT-6.2 Sol
- GPT-6.1 Terra
- Mistral Large 4

improvements.text: Model providers, lists and tool rows are now translated too

fixes.text: Codex now asks before it edits a file when the agent's tool policy says to ask
You can untick a saved Claude subscription model that your plan no longer runs

features.title: Discord, Microsoft Teams and localization
features.body:
You can now connect an agent to Discord or Microsoft Teams. Connect your own bot, and people talk to the agent in a direct message or by mentioning it in a channel.

We also added 7 languages to the app: English, Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese and Spanish. To change it, open **Settings**, then **Preferences**, then **Language**.

features.title: A new sign-in screen
features.body: The sign-in screen now shows a preview of what agents can do, next to the form. Sign-in errors also say what went wrong. For example, a wrong password now shows **Invalid email or password**.

fixes.text: Annotating a session no longer changes the session counts or moves it to the top
Traces keep arriving when many chats are open at the same time
Trace details that your app sends reach the trace again
A command now stops at its time limit, and when you press Stop

features.title: See what an agent needs before it runs
features.body:
When something an agent uses goes missing, the app now tells you before a run fails. The item shows **Needs setup** in the agent editor, with the reason under it. If the model can't run, a banner above the chat box says so, and Send stays off until you fix it.

- A missing MCP server, secret or connected app no longer stops a run. The agent runs without it.
- A scheduled run whose model needs setup is recorded once as skipped, instead of failing five times.

fixes.text: Invite links open the app in the project you were invited to

features.title: Agent chats start faster
features.body:
Agent chats start faster, because Agenta no longer repeats setup work at the start of each chat. Pi agents also finish their turn sooner.

- Organization owners and admins can test a connection from any project.
- A long chat no longer stops working because of a broken character in an old message.

features.title: A guided start for your first agent
features.body:
New accounts now get a short guided start that helps them build their first agent. The questions match the sign-up survey, so nobody answers the same thing twice.

- Automations that start on an event in a connected app no longer miss events.
- When you change an automation's event filters, the change now takes effect.
- If you host Agenta yourself, read the upgrade notes before you update.

features.title: Share AI provider connections
features.body:
Organization owners and admins can now add an AI provider connection once for the whole organization, instead of in every project. Find it in Settings, on the **Organization** tab.

- Choose which projects can use each connection. Picking single projects needs an Enterprise plan.
- Pick an organization connection in an agent's model list.

features.title: Security updates and agent-run fixes
features.body:
This release updates vulnerable dependencies across the web app, API, SDK and runner.

On self-hosted setups that override `HOME`, Codex runs no longer wait indefinitely on their first turn. Agent runs send the correct project even without an authorization header. The model picker shows a readable Kimi K3.1 Pro label, and session names no longer show a lock icon.
